subject: Action: Complete Whistic vendor profile and upload SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-cloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurements@acme-cloud.com
Date: 2025-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor security profile: please complete Whistic for procurement

Hi Karthik,

We're moving Redwood through our vendor review (thanks — excited to get this live). The security team has asked that you complete your Whistic vendor profile and upload the latest SOC 2 report and supporting evidence to the portal so we can finish our procurement checks.

Items they specifically called out: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), encryption and key management docs, network segmentation diagram, and an inventory manifest of third-party subprocessors. They've opened a Whistic request under Acme's workspace for "Redwood Inference". Link is below.

Can you confirm who on your side will own this and an ETA? Our deadline for vendor clearance is EOD 2025-05-26.

Whistic link: https://app.whistic.com/request/ACME-REQ-4821

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Senior Vendor Manager
Acme Cloud Solutions

(Attachment: purchase_order_5342.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2025-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security profile: please complete Whistic for procurement

Mina / Monica — looping you both in.

Mina: can you lead the Whistic onboarding (you handled Stripe & Nova last quarter so you know the flow)? Please populate the profile fields, upload SOC2 and the evidence bundle, and confirm the specific locations for encryption docs + subprocessors manifest. If you need anything from Legal for redactions, ping me and I'll escalate.

Monica: after Mina uploads, can you do a quick quality pass (ensure the answers line up to our SOC 2 and the CAIQ mapping) and publish the profile to Acme's request? If there are missing artifacts, please list them in the manifest and let me know.

Target: complete profile and initial uploads by EOD 2025-05-21 so we have time for Acme to review.

Thanks — Karthik
VP, Partnerships 
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood-inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2025-05-21T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security profile: please complete Whistic for procurement

On Wed, May 21, 2025 at 09:34 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Mina / Monica — looping you both in.
> 
> Mina: can you lead the Whistic onboarding (you handled Stripe & Nova last quarter so you know the flow)? Please populate the profile fields, upload SOC2 and the evidence bundle, and confirm the specific locations for encryption docs + subprocessors manifest. If you need anything from Legal for redactions, ping me and I'll escalate.
> 
> Monica: after Mina uploads, can you do a quick quality pass (ensure the answers line up to our SOC 2 and the CAIQ mapping) and publish the profile to Acme's request? If there are missing artifacts, please list them in the manifest and let me know.

Update: I completed the core Whistic questionnaire and uploaded the following artifacts to the Acme request: SOC2_report_2024.pdf (SOC 2 Type II), whistic_evidence_manifest.xlsx (detailed index of files + permissions), and evidence_bundle_2025-05-21.zip (contains network diagram, KMS architecture notes, vendor subprocessors csv).

Notes:
- I redacted customer-identifying examples per Legal guidance (redactions noted in the manifest).
- Encryption & KMS: provided KMS provider name, key rotation cadence, and screenshots of KMS console showing CMK tags (screenshot filenames in manifest).
- Subprocessors: CSV includes hostnames and vendor contact emails; sensitive columns (internal IPs) were removed.

Outstanding: two items Acme might request during review — (1) signed DPA excerpt for specific EU processing clauses (Legal has the template, but we should confirm whether Acme needs the signed doc in Whistic or just a pointer to DocuSign) and (2) a short runbook for incident response notification timelines (I drafted a 1-page summary and attached as runbook_summary.pdf inside the zip).

I flagged both in the Whistic portal comments and requested clarification from Tom.

Attachments uploaded: SOC2_report_2024.pdf, whistic_evidence_manifest.xlsx, evidence_bundle_2025-05-21.zip

— Mina
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-cloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2025-05-22T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security profile: please complete Whistic for procurement

Tom — thanks for the patience. I completed a review of the entries Mina uploaded and published the profile to your Acme request (status: "Submitted for Review"). 

Quick summary of what's now live in Whistic:
- Questionnaire responses filled and cross-checked against SOC2_report_2024.pdf and CAIQ mapping.
- Uploaded artifacts: SOC2_report_2024.pdf, evidence_bundle_2025-05-21.zip, whistic_evidence_manifest.xlsx, runbook_summary.pdf.
- Portal comment left calling out the DPA question — Legal has the signed template ready; Karthik, should I attach the signed DPA or wait for Acme to request the signed copy?

Tom, if your team wants any additional evidence (e.g., raw log retention policies or audit-trail exports), tell me which folder in the manifest you'd like expanded and we can provide a follow-up bundle.

Whistic profile link: https://app.whistic.com/company/redwood-inference/profile
Drive link to raw artifacts (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-Security-Evidence

Let me know if Acme needs anything else to close vendor clearance.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: whistic_evidence_manifest.xlsx)
